observations.title: Empowering LLMs by hybrid retrieval-augmented generation for domain ...
observations.snippet: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performances in generic question-answering (QA) but often suffer from domain gaps and outdated knowledge in smart manufacturing (SM). Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based on LLMs has emerged as a potential approach by incorporating an external knowledge base.
